adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is assigned `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null` around lines ~1060). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining causes a silent no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` (populated from co-hosts in the preceding `teamMemberPromises` loop) are never added. This drops co-host destination calendars exactly when organizer/event-type has none.
